digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure / CI workflow parity collection
propositions: _collect_node_ids launches nested pytest collection subprocess without --basetemp, causing session cleanup to potentially delete or traverse shared numbered temp roots from concurrent runs
pytest session shutdown traversal of the shared numbered temp root via cleanup_numbered_dir/rmtree can delete or stall on another run's temp tree
passing a caller-owned private --basetemp directory to _collect_node_ids isolates its temp state without changing collection selection, stdout parsing, or timeout behavior
regression test proves that nested collection with poisoned shared numbered temp root removes entries, while private basetemp preserves exact sentinel entries
